author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices up and down, a tick-tock beat, finding a special note, echoing short patterns and taking turns, with the mouse and clock rhyme.

classes.title: Mouse runs up, runs down
classes.goal: Follow the tune as the mouse runs up the clock and back down.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune climbs up, then runs back down

classes.parentPrompt: Run your fingers up your child's arm with the tune, then back down to the hand.
classes.childAction: Run your fingers up high, then scurry back down.
classes.bridge: Up the keys to the right is up the clock; left is back down.

intro.caption: Up the clock, down the clock
intro.parentCue: run your fingers up your child's arm

games.caption: Mouse runs up, then down
games.parentCue: Point up as the lights climb, down as they fall

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a tune go up and down.

classes.title: Tick, tock, the clock
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each tick and tock while the grown-up plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: A clock beat comes in pairs: tick, tock

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand; say 'tick, tock' and tap together, then let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key on each tick and each tock.
classes.bridge: Your taps are the clock's pendulum: tick on one side, tock on the other.

games.caption: Hickory dickory dock
games.parentCue: Say 'tick, tock' softly as you tap

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: tapping a steady tick-tock beat.

classes.title: Find the mouse's F
classes.goal: Find F by touch: it sits just left of the three black keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the three black keys to find one white key

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger to the three black keys, then slide left onto F.
classes.childAction: Touch the three black keys, slide left, and press F gently.
classes.bridge: The three black keys are the clock; F is the mouse hole just to its left.

intro.caption: Find the three black keys
intro.parentCue: let your child touch them first, then find F

games.caption: F, F, F: one, two, three

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding one key by its landmark.

classes.title: Mouse squeaks back
classes.goal: Listen to a short 2 or 3 note call, then play it back the same.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding a short pattern in mind, then repeating it

classes.parentPrompt: Play or sing the call first, then point to your child: your turn.
classes.childAction: Listen to the squeak, then play it back the same.
classes.bridge: The big clock calls; the little mouse squeaks it back, the same keys.

intro.caption: Clock calls, mouse squeaks back
intro.parentCue: listen together first, then let your child copy

games.caption: Hick-o-ry: E, F, G
games.parentCue: Point to each key before your child plays

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening, remembering and copying short patterns.

classes.title: Up the clock and back
classes.goal: Copy a pattern going up, then the same keys coming back down.

mathTarget.parentLine: Going up, then the same way back down

classes.parentPrompt: Play up, then down the same keys; hold your hands like a mirror and let your child copy.
classes.childAction: Climb up three keys, then come down the same three.
classes.bridge: The mouse climbs up the clock, then runs down the very same steps.

intro.caption: Up, then the same way down
intro.parentCue: show each part once, then let your child copy

games.caption: Up the clock: E, F, G
games.parentCue: Walk your fingers up your child's arm

games.caption: Down the clock: G, F, E
games.parentCue: Now walk your fingers back down

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: copying a pattern that goes up and back.

classes.title: Wait for the F
classes.goal: Wait while the grown-up plays, then play F when it is your turn.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your part, then joining in

classes.parentPrompt: Play your part, then nod to your child just before each F; smile while they wait.
classes.childAction: Wait for the nod, then press F.
classes.bridge: The mouse waits in its hole, then pops out on F.

intro.caption: Wait, wait... now F!
intro.parentCue: nod to your child when it is their turn

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for a turn, then joining in.

classes.title: F or E? Pick one
classes.goal: Play two special notes, F and E, choosing the right one by listening.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound into one of two boxes

classes.parentPrompt: Point to F or E before each turn at first, then let your child choose.
classes.childAction: Listen, choose F or E, and press the right one.
classes.bridge: F is the mouse hole; E is its next-door neighbour, one key left.

intro.caption: Mouse hole F, or E next door?
intro.parentCue: point first, then let your child choose alone

games.caption: Find F, then E
games.parentCue: Point to each key, say its name

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling two sounds apart and choosing one.

classes.title: Tick-tock together
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, sharing one steady beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keep one beat together

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and nod 'tick, tock' with your head; keep going if your child misses.
classes.childAction: Play your notes and nod along with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Two hands on one clock: both tick at the same speed.

intro.caption: Two players, one clock
intro.parentCue: nod the beat so your child can see it

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, one beat.

classes.title: Clock concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and notice the first line coming back at the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: The first line comes back at the end

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; cheer when 'hickory dickory dock' comes back, then bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, cheer when the first line returns, then bow.
classes.bridge: The song starts at the clock, runs up and down, then ends there again.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
